facts.fact: The National Bank of Ethiopia directed on 10 December 2025 that all banks open new accounts using the VeriFayda 2 eKYC system (EthSwitch eKYC Service), which replaces VeriFayda 1 used previously.
The National Bank of Ethiopia set 1 December 2025 to 30 March 2026 for banks to link all active customer accounts to Fayda ID, by mobile app or branch.
